verdict.rationale: The Dataverse Web API that backs Dynamics 365 Sales documents creating table rows via POST, including related rows in one deep insert, and batching operations atomically in change sets. That covers the record-creation step an external agent would perform. Separately, the first-party Sales Qualification Agent researches leads using internal and external data, but the evidence does not show this enrichment can be driven through the API or an MCP server. Missing for 10: any MCP server, an API-driven company-data enrichment step, documented owner assignment via API, an end-to-end agent workflow example, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent enrich a new lead end-to-end via the API or MCP server — creating the record, filling company data, and assigning an owner

citations.quote: Send a `POST` request to create table rows, including related rows in a single deep insert operation.
Group multiple operations into a single HTTP request, optionally within a change set to ensure they succeed or fail as a unit.
Sales Qualification Agent autonomously researches leads using internal and external data
